aiDescription.summary: This bill amends the Illegal Immigration Reform and Immigrant Responsibility Act to require 501(c)(3) nonprofits that pay individuals for political services or to take an active part in political management or campaigns to enroll in and comply with the federal E‑Verify program. It applies nationwide to tax‑exempt public charities and covers paid (not volunteer) workers, obligating organizations to use E‑Verify to confirm workers' authorization to work in the United States.

impact.summary: The bill requires 501(c)(3) tax‑exempt nonprofits that pay people to do political work or take active roles in political campaigns to enroll in and follow the federal E‑Verify program. It would affect charities and community groups nationwide and the Department of Homeland Security/USCIS, which operates E‑Verify.

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on the Judiciary, and in addition to the Committee on Education and Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
